articles.title: 玩具業巨擘孩之寶遭駭，被竊數百人個資
articles.summary:
玩具業巨擘孩之寶（Hasbro）近日通報員工個資外洩事件，目前公開資料顯示，有436名麻州居民受到影響，但整體受影響人數尚未公布。這起事件可能與孩之寶今年3月發現的網路攻擊有關，但公司目前尚未確認兩者是否為同一起事件。
孩之寶近日以電子郵件通知受影響人員，外洩資料可能包含電子郵件地址、郵寄地址、電話號碼、國民身分識別號碼及財務資訊等，並提醒受影響人員持續檢查帳戶與信用紀錄，留意可疑活動及釣魚郵件。這批通知也是孩之寶向美國州政府檢察長辦公室提交的資料外洩通報文件之一。
articles.title_zh: 玩具業巨擘孩之寶遭駭，被竊數百人個資
articles.summary_zh:
玩具業巨擘孩之寶（Hasbro）近日通報員工個資外洩事件，目前公開資料顯示，有436名麻州居民受到影響，但整體受影響人數尚未公布。這起事件可能與孩之寶今年3月發現的網路攻擊有關，但公司目前尚未確認兩者是否為同一起事件。
孩之寶近日以電子郵件通知受影響人員，外洩資料可能包含電子郵件地址、郵寄地址、電話號碼、國民身分識別號碼及財務資訊等，並提醒受影響人員持續檢查帳戶與信用紀錄，留意可疑活動及釣魚郵件。這批通知也是孩之寶向美國州政府檢察長辦公室提交的資料外洩通報文件之一。

articles.summary: Key Takeaways : Photonics changes chiplet design from a placement problem into a multi-physics co-design problem because thermal, mechanical, electromagnetic, and optical effects interact bidirectionally. Chip architects should start with traffic patterns, system architecture, and verifiable interface contracts before deciding where optics belongs. articles.title: Pixel’s Now Playing is about to get its lost feature back, and we saw the proof
articles.summary: Credit: Joe Maring / Android Authority TL;DR Google updated the Now Playing app with subtle interface tweaks. It’s also moving closer to restoring Now Playing notifications, which it removed earlier this year. We have spotted Now Playing’s upcoming support for secondary user accounts on Pixel devices. Beyond that, a sync feature for Now Playing history is in the works. Now Playing is a Pixel-exclusive feature with few haters, but Google managed to rile up users when it refashioned it as a separate app this March . The supposed upgrade broke key functionality for users, including the ability to sync tracks with third-party services like Last.fm. Now the app is getting a new update with certain functionality tweaks — and the bigger promise of getting lost features back.

articles.title: I lived with Samsung’s worst 2025 Android phone for a year. Here’s why I’m finally giving up
articles.summary: Three months after Samsung launched the three mainline Galaxy S25 models, it followed up with a fourth offering: the Galaxy S25 Edge. The Galaxy S25 Edge came with better specs and fewer compromises than the iPhone Air, but one year later, Samsung’s slim flagship has no successor in sight. I bought the Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge in cash, with no promotions or discounts, and used it for the last year. Whenever I wasn’t reviewing a new Android phone, the Galaxy S25 Edge was my daily driver. I still love the concept, but I struggled to live with Samsung’s execution.

articles.title: ChatGPT and Reddit now face EU's toughest online safety rules
articles.summary: OpenAI’s ChatGPT will have to comply with tougher EU rules such as removing illegal content or face potential fines, the European Commission said on Monday, as Brussels grapples with how its existing digital regulation applies to rapidly evolving AI services. The Commission said the chatbot, social media forum Reddit, and gaming platform Roblox would be classified as so-called very large online platforms under the EU Digital Services Act, its landmark online safety regime. Roman is just the second NASA-led astrophysics mission to launch this century, following the launch of Webb in 2021 . articles.summary:
